item.name: 🎯 Generate Intelligent Code - User Profile Feature

body.raw:
{
  "intent": "Add user profile management feature",
  "requirements": "Create a complete user profile system with update capabilities, validation, and audit logging. Include profile image upload, personal information management, and privacy settings.",
  "targetFiles": ["src/api/users.js", "src/components/UserProfile.jsx"],
  "businessGoal": "Improve user experience and data accuracy",
  "changeType": "feature"
}

{
  "intent": "Add JWT authentication to product and order APIs",
  "requirements": "Implement secure JWT-based authentication that follows our security standards and integrates with existing user management. Include refresh token mechanism and role-based access control.",
  "targetFiles": ["src/api/products.js", "src/api/orders.js", "src/middleware/auth.js"],
  "businessGoal": "Secure customer data and enable personalized shopping",
  "changeType": "security-enhancement"
}

{
  "intent": "Optimize slow database queries in user dashboard",
  "requirements": "Improve query performance while maintaining data accuracy and implementing proper caching. Add database indexing strategies and query optimization.",
  "targetFiles": ["src/services/dashboardService.js", "src/models/User.js"],
  "businessGoal": "Reduce page load time from 3s to under 1s",
  "changeType": "optimization"
}

{
  "intent": "Implement subscription billing system",
  "requirements": "Add complete subscription management with multiple plans, billing cycles, and payment processing integration. Include invoice generation, payment retries, and subscription lifecycle management.",
  "targetFiles": ["src/api/subscriptions.js", "src/models/Subscription.js", "src/services/billingService.js"],
  "businessGoal": "Enable recurring revenue model",
  "changeType": "feature"
}
